evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep never probed for concerns about movers not showing up on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during discovery.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep did not identify the day of the week (Thursday, Nov 5) as part of any value/pricing tier or offer flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep provided estimate ($1,210) and availability window (8:30-9am) but never explicitly asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or mentioned rate lock and no deposit before attempting to close.

top_strength: Jules built strong rapport by acknowledging the customer's prior positive experience, confirming specific mover names (Nick and Ian), and making a proactive note to request them—showing genuine attentiveness to what mattered to the customer.
coaching_note: This is a repeat customer in a familiar scenario, which worked against structure: Jules skipped the two-concerns discovery question entirely, delivered no promises about on-time guarantee or damage coverage, never asked 'How do you feel about that?' after pricing, and never explicitly asked for the business—instead drifting into scheduling logistics without a closing ask.
